_about: Messages that need several tools (2026-11-07), for chat.loop_final: every sentence is written for this file. 'together' asks for independent things the model can call in one round; 'chain' needs a result before it knows the next call, which a round that settles the turn cuts off; 'search' is what MASAMONG_LOOP_FINAL=search can lose. Run it with MASAMONG_SCENARIO_FILE=testdata/scenarios_multi_ko.json and MASAMONG_LOOP_FINAL=off, tools and search, and compare problems, tool_loop.rounds and timing_ms in the report.
